definition: a written order telling a bank to pay a specific amount of money from your account

collocations.example: She sat down to write a check for the monthly rent.
Many older customers still prefer to pay by check.

definition: the dominant individual in a group of people or animals

collocations.example: The alpha male in a wolf pack controls access to food.
He tries to act like an alpha whenever new colleagues arrive.

definition: a British nobleman ranking above a viscount and below a marquess

collocations.example: When his father died, he became an earl at just nineteen.
The king granted him the title of earl for his loyalty.

definition: to join together to form a single central group while keeping some independence

collocations.example: The small states agreed to federate into one larger nation.
Several local unions chose to federate with the national body.

definition: a member of a small, independent fighting group that attacks a larger army by surprise

collocations.example: The rebels relied on guerrilla warfare to wear down the army.
A former guerrilla fighter now serves in the new government.

definition: sexually attracted to people of one's own sex

collocations.example: The film portrays a long-term homosexual relationship with warmth and honesty.
He became the first openly homosexual member of the council.

definition: an informal word for a man or boy

collocations.example: Everyone agrees he is a nice chap to work with.
Don't worry about it, old chap; these things happen.

definition: to throw something carelessly or casually

collocations.example: Don't chuck away those old boxes; we may need them later.
Chuck the ball over to me when you're ready.

definition: an illegal, addictive drug made from the leaves of the coca plant

collocations.example: Police caught him trying to snort cocaine in the restroom.
She spent years battling to recover after becoming addicted to cocaine.

definition: a valley, especially a broad open one in northern England

collocations.example: Sheep grazed peacefully across the wide green dale.
The path winds down the dale toward the river.

definition: to fail to meet someone's hopes or expectations; to make someone unhappy

collocations.example: Poor service will quickly dissatisfy customers and drive them elsewhere.
The final decision seemed to deeply dissatisfy almost everyone involved.

definition: a small, imaginary creature in fairy tales, usually shown as a short man with a beard

collocations.example: In the tale, a bearded dwarf forges a magic ring.
The heroes set out to find the dwarf's hidden treasure.

definition: a small, imaginary creature with magical powers and pointed ears, found in fairy tales

collocations.example: A mischievous elf hid the farmer's tools every single night.
At the party, he was dressed as an elf with pointed ears.

definition: a powerful, illegal, and highly addictive drug made from morphine

collocations.example: He became addicted to heroin after years of chronic pain.
The singer nearly died from a heroin overdose last year.

definition: the cruel killing of a large number of people who cannot defend themselves

collocations.example: The town still mourns the victims of that brutal massacre.
The regime was accused of carrying out a massacre of civilians.

definition: a gentle golf stroke made on the green to roll the ball into the hole

collocations.example: He sank a tricky putt to win the match.
Even professionals sometimes miss a short putt under pressure.

definition: the smallest possible amount of energy or matter in physics

collocations.example: A photon carries a single quantum of light energy.
The atom absorbed a quantum of energy and then jumped.

definition: to wander or travel around an area with no fixed destination

collocations.example: As a young man, he loved to rove around Europe alone.
She let her eyes rove across the crowded hall.

definition: in golf, the small area or peg from which a player hits the ball at the start of a hole

collocations.example: A crowd gathered near the first tee to watch.

collocations.collocation: set the ball on the tee
collocations.example: She set the ball on the tee and took her stance.

definition: to walk with short, unsteady steps, as a young child does

collocations.example: The baby began to toddle toward her father's open arms.
The little boy toddled along behind his older sister.

definition: a woman in stories who is believed to have magic powers, often used for evil

collocations.example: In the fairy tale, a wicked witch locks her in a tower.
The prince was freed only when the witch's spell was broken.

definition: a man in stories who has magic powers

collocations.example: A powerful wizard taught the boy how to use magic.
Nobody could undo the old wizard's powerful spell.

definition: used to express sadness, pity, or regret about something

collocations.example: Everyone hoped he would recover, but alas, he did not.
We arrived at the gate, but alas, too late.

definition: one of the twelve men chosen by Jesus Christ to teach and spread his message

collocations.example: The painting shows Jesus surrounded by the twelve apostles.
He is remembered as a faithful apostle of the early church.

definition: a baby or very young child

collocations.example: The mother cradled her newborn babe against her chest.
She traveled across the country with a babe in arms.

definition: a sharp point that sticks out backward from a hook, arrow, or wire

collocations.example: The barb of a hook can be hard to remove.
His sleeve caught on a barb of the wire fence.

definition: to split or cut something into parts, often with force

collocations.example: The heavy blade cleaved through bone and wood alike.
One blow cleaved open the heavy wooden door.

definition: an illness in which waste from the body is very watery and comes too often

collocations.example: Many travelers suffer from diarrhea after drinking unclean water.
He suffered a bout of diarrhea during the long trip.

definition: the scientific study of how diseases spread and can be controlled in populations

collocations.example: She decided to study epidemiology after the global outbreak.
Researchers examined the epidemiology of flu in large cities.

definition: the scientific description and study of the customs of individual peoples and cultures

collocations.example: The team spent a year conducting ethnography in a remote village.
This is considered a work of ethnography about rural life.

definition: a supporter of fascism, a system of strict government control with no opposition allowed

collocations.example: He was exposed as a dangerous fascist by the press.
In 1922 the fascists seized power across the whole nation.

definition: a person who lives a wandering life and does not settle in one place

collocations.example: After college, she lived like a gypsy, moving from town to town.
He spent his twenties as a wandering gypsy with no fixed home.

definition: a long weapon with a pointed metal end, used by soldiers on horseback in the past

collocations.example: Each mounted soldier had to carry a lance into battle.
The knight began to lower the lance before his charge.

definition: the branch of philosophy that studies the nature of existence, reality, and being

collocations.example: He turned to study metaphysics after years in science.
Whether time truly exists is a question of metaphysics.

definition: an important Christian religious ceremony, such as baptism or marriage

collocations.example: The faithful lined up to receive the sacrament at the altar.
In their church, marriage is regarded as a holy sacrament.

definition: a person who studies religion and the nature of God

collocations.example: A leading theologian was invited to speak at the conference.
Theologians argue about this question across many centuries.

definition: an official in ancient Rome chosen to protect the rights of ordinary people

collocations.example: The citizens would elect a tribune to defend their interests.
He acted as a tribune of the people against the nobles.

definition: to write something using a typewriter

collocations.example: She went to night classes to learn to typewrite.
Please typewrite a document listing all the new charges.

definition: one of the original people who lived in a land, especially in Australia

collocations.example: He is proud to be an Australian Aborigine with deep roots.
The new law aimed to protect the rights of Aborigines.

definition: a test to find out what substances are present in something and in what amounts

collocations.example: The lab will perform an assay to measure the gold content.
Doctors ordered a blood assay to check her hormone levels.

definition: to take away a close relative or friend from someone, especially through death

collocations.example: War can cruelly bereave parents of their only children.
The whole town was bereaved by the sudden tragedy.

definition: boring or dull; without any special quality

collocations.example: The food at the new place was pretty blah.
It was just a gray, blah day with nothing to do.

definition: a man who behaves dishonestly or unfairly, especially toward women

collocations.example: Only an absolute cad would treat a guest so rudely.
He behaved like a cad, lying to everyone he met.

definition: a type of cancer that begins in the skin or in the tissue lining the body's organs

collocations.example: He was diagnosed with carcinoma of the lung last spring.
The dermatologist removed a small basal cell carcinoma.

definition: an informal, somewhat old-fashioned word for a woman

collocations.example: His grandmother was a tough dame who feared nothing.
In those films, the hero always chases after dames.

definition: located far from the center of the body or from the point where a limb joins it

collocations.example: The break occurred at the distal end of the bone.
The injury was located distal to the knee joint.

definition: an informal word for an illegal drug, especially marijuana

collocations.example: He was arrested for trying to sell dope near the school.
Police finally caught the neighborhood dope dealer.

definition: a male duck

collocations.example: A green-headed mallard drake swam across the quiet pond.
A hunter admired the drake's feathers after the shot.

definition: a priest or other official of the Christian church

collocations.example: A learned ecclesiastic wrote the preface to the book.
He wore the long black robes of an ecclesiastic.

definition: relating to efforts to bring together different Christian churches

collocations.example: The ecumenical council sought unity among the divided churches.
Their new project is broad and ecumenical in spirit.
